name: solera
description: AI-driven project workflow plugin with a three-axis model: Living (Identity, Personas, Journeys, Narratives, Concepts), Time-bound (Milestones, Stories, Action Items), and Immutable (Releases). Humans draw Concepts (and the Personas/Journeys/Narratives upstream of them) and agree on Milestones; AI decomposes Stories into commit-sized Action Items and proposes updates to the Living map at wrap-up. Workspace data lives in `.solera/`. Supports v2→v4 and v3→v4 assisted migration.
